map.含税还原不含税（本页代码口径，税率按百分数输入先 ÷100）：不含税金额=含税金: Tax-inclusive to tax-exclusive (code basis on this page, rate entered as a percentage and first ÷100): tax-exclusive amount = tax-inclusive amount ÷ (1+rate decimal); linked values: VAT = tax-inclusive − tax-exclusive, tax share of tax-inclusive = tax ÷ (tax-inclusive||1) × 100 (%). Validation: both fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Rule: no fixed grading; at 13% the tax-exclusive amount is about 88.5% of the tax-inclusive amount, and the main result keeps 2 decimal places.
